app_name: gcheck · Diagnostic Tool for Google AI Developers
welcome: Welcome! / 欢迎！/ ¡Bienvenido! / ようこそ！
select_language:
Please select your language / 请选择语言：
Selecciona tu idioma / 言語を選択してください：
trust_prompt: Allow gcheck to scan files in this directory for API keys and configuration settings? (API keys are processed locally and never stored or shared.)
trust_denied: Directory scan canceled. You can still enter your API key manually.
api_finding_notice: Validates your key against Gemini API endpoints. Need a key? Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/
api_finding_running: Scanning current directory for API keys...
api_finding_found: Found API key variable ({var_name}) in {file}:{line}. Use this key or enter a new key below:
api_finding_found_multiple: Found {count} API keys in this directory. Select a key or enter one manually:
api_finding_not_found: No API keys found in current directory. Enter your Gemini API key below.
api_finding_scan_timeout: Directory scan timed out. Enter your Gemini API key below:
api_finding_scan_error: Directory scan could not be completed. Enter your Gemini API key below:
api_finding_input_placeholder: Enter your Gemini API key (e.g. AIzaSy...)
api_finding_token_notice: Testing this key sends a lightweight request to the Gemini API and may consume 1 request from your quota. Continue?
api_test_running: Validating API key credentials with Google...
api_test_generating: Sending diagnostic test prompt to model...
api_test_blocked_reason: Response was not generated. Status reason: {reason}
api_test_no_generate_model: API key is valid, but no text generation model was accessible for testing.
api_test_troubleshooting_hint: Still having issues? Look up the error code in Google's troubleshooting guide: {url}
api_rec_invalid_1: Google rejected the key. It may be mistyped, truncated, or revoked.
api_rec_invalid_2: Generate a new API key at {url} and copy the full key string.
api_rec_invalid_3: Gemini API keys typically start with 'AIzaSy' or 'AQ...'. Check for missing characters.
api_rec_invalid_4: If your key was created in an older project, verify it is still active in Google AI Studio.
api_rec_invalid_5: Ensure no leading/trailing spaces or quotes were accidentally copied.
api_rec_leaked_1: Google detected this key exposed somewhere public (e.g. a public repo, gist, or forum post) and blocked it automatically.
api_rec_leaked_2: Treat this key as compromised — don't reuse it, even privately, and don't just wait for it to start working again.
api_rec_leaked_4: Before using the new key, remove the old one from wherever it was exposed (git history, logs, shared docs, chat) and revoke it in Google AI Studio if it still shows as active.
api_block_tip_safety: This isn't a key problem — Google's content filters withheld the reply. It may pass on a retry; if it keeps happening, it's the prompt or the model's default safety settings, not your key.
api_block_tip_recitation: This isn't a key problem — the reply looked too close to existing text and was withheld. Try a more specific prompt or a higher temperature.
api_block_tip_language: This isn't a key problem — the prompt's language isn't supported for generation. Try an English-language prompt.
api_block_tip_default: This isn't a key problem — the model didn't produce a text reply for this request.
api_rec_location_1: The request originated from a region where the Gemini API is currently unavailable.
api_rec_location_2: This restriction applies to the Gemini API specifically; other Google services may be unaffected.
api_rec_location_freetier_1: The Gemini API free tier is not supported in this region, but paid requests are available.
api_rec_location_freetier_2: Enable Pay-As-You-Go billing for your project in Google AI Studio: {url}
api_rec_transient_1: The request reached Google, but the server encountered a transient error.
api_rec_transient_2: Wait a few moments, then select 'Retry'.
api_rec_transient_3: Check the Google Cloud Status Dashboard for service disruptions: {url}
api_rec_bad_cred_title: Invalid Key Format or Auth Type
api_rec_bad_cred_1: The credential provided was rejected by Google AI endpoints.
api_rec_bad_cred_2: Ensure you are using a valid Gemini API key rather than an OAuth access token or service account key.
api_rec_bad_cred_3: Obtain a fresh API key from Google AI Studio: {url}
api_rec_bad_cred_4: Pass the API key string directly rather than an OAuth access token.
api_rec_bad_cred_5: Check for stray quotes, spaces, or truncation when copying.
api_rec_permission_1: Ensure the 'Generative Language API' is enabled for project{proj}.
api_rec_permission_2: Check key restriction settings in Google Cloud Console (Credentials → Key Restrictions).
api_rec_permission_3: Verify HTTP referrer, IP address, or API restriction rules on the key.
api_rec_permission_4: Test with an unrestricted key created in Google AI Studio: {url}
api_rec_model_notfound_1: The key is valid, but does not have access to the specified model.
api_rec_model_notfound_2: Test with a generally available model like 'gemini-1.5-flash'.
api_rec_model_notfound_3: Try testing again — this tool already auto-picks a supported model where possible.
api_rec_unimplemented_1: This isn't a problem with your key — the model or operation being tested doesn't support this request at all.
api_rec_unimplemented_2: Retrying won't change the result; try a different model, or check Google's API reference for what this model/operation supports.
api_rec_tls_cert_title: Your Python can't verify Google's TLS certificate.
api_rec_tls_cert_1: The network is fine — your Python's certificate trust store is empty or broken.
api_rec_tls_cert_2: This is common with the python.org installer on macOS.
api_rec_tls_cert_3: Fix it by running the bundled installer command (adjust the version):
api_rec_tls_cert_4: Or install a CA bundle into this interpreter:
api_rec_tls_cert_5: Then try testing your key again.
api_rec_network_1: The key was never tested — the request didn't reach Google.
api_rec_network_2: Gemini API access may be restricted in your region. See supported regions: {url}
api_rec_network_3: If your network is restricting access to Google services, run the network diagnostics from the previous step again.
api_rec_network_4: Then re-run this test once connectivity is restored.
api_rec_fallback_1: Double-check the key at {url} and try again.
api_rec_billing_1: API key is valid, but paid-tier billing issues are blocking requests.
api_rec_billing_2: Check for expired payment methods, depleted billing credits, or spending limits.
api_rec_billing_3: Update payment details and project billing status in Google AI Studio: {url}
api_rec_billing_4: Open the project in AI Studio to manage credits/billing:  {url}
api_rec_quota_generic_1: Your API key has exceeded its rate limit or daily usage quota.
api_rec_quota_generic_2: For short-term rate limits, wait 60 seconds before retrying.
api_rec_quota_generic_3: To increase usage limits, enable billing or request a quota increase: {url}
api_rec_quota_detail_1: The key is valid — you've hit a usage limit, not an auth problem.
api_rec_quota_daily_wait_1: This is a daily cap; it resets around midnight US Pacific time —
api_rec_quota_daily_wait_2: waiting a few seconds won't clear it.
api_rec_quota_retry_delay: This is a short-term limit — wait ~{seconds}s and retry.
api_rec_quota_perminute_wait: This is a per-minute limit — wait ~60s and retry.
api_rec_quota_freetier_fix_1: You're on the free tier. To raise limits, enable billing (paid tier):
api_rec_quota_paidtier_fix_1: To raise limits, request a quota increase:
diag_gateway_down: Local network gateway unreachable. Your device appears offline.
diag_gateway_down_rec: Check your Wi-Fi or Ethernet connection, router status, and local network adapter settings.
diag_gateway_down_but_baseline_ok: Default gateway did not respond on port 80, but external baseline endpoints are reachable. Local connection is functional.
diag_baseline_down: Local network is connected, but baseline internet endpoints (e.g. Cloudflare, Python) are unreachable.
diag_baseline_down_rec1: Verify internet access, check WAN/router connection, and inspect local DNS settings.
diag_all_ok: All baseline internet endpoints and Google AI domains resolved and connected successfully.
diag_all_ok_rec: No network issues detected. If API calls fail later, check API key permissions and quota.
diag_google_targeted: General internet connection is active ({baseline_ok}/{baseline_total}), but {google_failed}/{google_total} Google domains are unreachable.
diag_recheck_periodically: Re-run this check periodically; connectivity issues can be intermittent.
diag_check_failed_body: A background check stopped unexpectedly ({error}) and the diagnosis could not be completed.
diag_check_failed_rec: Select 'Check again' to retry. If it keeps failing, the network may be closing connections mid-request.
diag_google_region_hint: Gemini API access may be restricted on this network. See supported regions: {url}
diag_local_trust_store_hint: Python TLS trust store is missing root CA certificates. Fix by running 'Install Certificates.command' (macOS) or installing 'certifi' (`pip install certifi`).
diag_tls13_stall_hint: TLS 1.3 negotiation stalled; fallback to TLS 1.2 succeeded. This is an environment-specific TLS stack behavior.
